answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. A new identity deposits 100 units, released only as its fingerprint — timing, partners, task mix — stays consistent across epochs. Each epoch a beacon pulse triggers a check; ridge auditors freeze clones sharing one fingerprint. Ten verified epochs carve a marble record and return the bond. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 units; an honest agent deposits 100 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
